name: codebase-navigator-prompt
body:
The distributed `codebase-navigator` agent prompt file `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` (product source embedded via `include_str!` and installed by `apg init` into `~/.opencode/agents/`). It carries the per-task implementation cadence (its "Implementation flow" section) and, for `requirements.requirement.navigator-no-unguarded-main-git`, its frontmatter `bash:` git grants: drop `git merge *`, `git checkout *`, `git switch *`; narrow `git worktree *` to `git worktree list *`; narrow the blanket `git branch *` to the exact read-only `git branch --show-current` (a blanket `git branch *` admits ref-writing `-f`/`-D`/`-m`); keep `git rebase *` (worktree-onto-main sync, run inside the worktree) and read-only `git status *`/`git diff *`/`git log *`; the body states main is integrated only via `apg project merge`.

Deliberately a NARROW owner, distinct from the broad `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance`: `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check` then maps coverage exactly to this one file. Product source in `solution.container.opencode-suite`; the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts never edited by a change-set.

implemented-by: `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`.
